categories.name: Printed items and parts
categories.blurb: Made to order on our printers, in 12 lanes. Every price here is a sample, worked out from material and machine time, until a real unit has been made and timed.

categories.name: Printers
categories.blurb: Machines a small shop can run and resell, including the two we print on. Prices are the maker's list price as seen on the date shown.

categories.name: Filament and materials
categories.blurb: Real spools we print with, from PLA to carbon-fibre nylon, and the dryers that keep them printable.

categories.name: Printer repair parts
categories.blurb: Parts to keep printers running instead of throwing them away. Bambu Lab P1S and QIDI X-Max 3 first, then common parts.

items.name: Tomte, set of three for Yule

items.name: Candle arch for battery tea lights

items.name: Yggdrasil wall plaque, 25 cm

items.name: Round shield wall plaque, 25 cm

items.name: Longhouse dice tower
items.blurb: Drop the dice in the smoke hole; they tumble out the front door.

items.name: Makeup drawer insert, measured to your drawer
items.blurb: Trays cut to the inside of your own drawer, with wells sized to what you own: foundation, compacts, pencils, brushes. Printed in tiles that lock together.

items.name: Lipstick and lip-gloss tower, 24 slots

items.blurb: Stands palettes on edge like books so you can pull one without unstacking the rest. Tell us the palettes; we size each slot.

items.name: Rotating makeup carousel, three tiers

items.name: Nail polish wall rack, 30 bottles
items.blurb: Three shelves with a lip, screwed to the wall, so every colour is seen at once. Shelf depth set to your bottles.

items.name: Draugr mask: the Norse undead, full face
items.blurb: A barrow-wight's face in weathered bone, our own design. Wide eye openings for side vision, vents at the nose and mouth, a padded TPU strap. Adult size.

items.name: Plague doctor mask
items.blurb: The long-beaked mask, hollow and light, with a vented beak and wide eye rings. Adult size; lenses left open, never glazed.

items.name: Skull half mask, open jaw
items.blurb: Covers the eyes and nose and stops at the lip, so you can talk, drink and eat in it all night. Adult size.

items.name: Jack-o'-lantern mask
items.blurb: A carved pumpkin face in orange, the grin cut open for air. Adult size.

items.name: Fenris wolf mask
items.blurb: The bound wolf of the Norse end of the world, faceted and low-poly, painted or left raw. Adult size.

items.name: Krampus mask with curled horns
items.blurb: Horns printed separately and pinned on, so it wears from Halloween through Yule. Adult size.

items.name: Masquerade half mask, filigree
items.blurb: Thin knotwork lace over the eyes, light enough to forget you are wearing it. Ribbon ties.

items.name: Any of our masks fitted to your face
items.blurb: Send a phone face scan and we fit the inside of the mask to it: no pressure on the nose, no gap at the cheek. Priced from here.

items.name: Gridfinity baseplate, cut to your drawer
items.blurb: The open 42 mm grid, sized to the inside of your drawer to the millimetre, in as many pieces as your printer bed needs. Bins click in anywhere.

items.name: Gridfinity bins, set of 12 mixed sizes
items.blurb: Small, long and deep bins with label lips and scoop fronts, for screws, bits, SD cards and everything that rattles.

items.name: Drawer dividers measured to your drawer
items.blurb: Interlocking slats for a kitchen or desk drawer that no store divider fits. Send the inside measurements; we send the grid.

items.name: Pegboard hooks and holders, set of 15
items.blurb: Hooks, cups, a screwdriver rack and a plier holder for standard 1/4-inch-hole pegboard, locking so they do not lift off.

items.name: Driver bit and drill index, made to your set
items.blurb: One slot per bit, sized and labelled, so the 3 mm is always where the 3 mm goes.

items.name: Under-desk cable trays and clips, set of 10
items.blurb: Screw-on clips and two short trays that keep chargers and power strips off the floor.

items.name: Wall spool rack for filament, yarn or wire
items.blurb: A wall rail with axle arms that hold spools you can still turn and pull from.

items.name: Hollow runestone for set dressing
items.blurb: A carved-look stone a person can carry, printed in sections around a light infill, primed for paint. The rune band reads what you choose, spelled correctly in the Younger Futhark.

items.name: Spectacle helmet, costume piece
items.blurb: A rounded cap with the eye-guard of the one tenth-century helmet found whole in Norway. No horns: no Viking helmet ever had them. Costume only: it protects nothing.

items.name: Bearded axe, blunt prop head
items.blurb: A bearded axe head with no edge, made to slide onto a wooden haft you supply or we cut. For the screen and the stage, not for chopping.

items.name: Period lantern shell for an LED candle
items.blurb: A horn-window lantern look with a slot for a battery tea light, so the fire on set never needs a fire marshal.

items.name: Dummy two-way radio and hero phone shells
items.blurb: Non-working shells for background actors: weighted, painted, clipped to a belt. Nothing inside to break.

items.name: Sci-fi panel greebles, set dressing kit
items.blurb: Vents, pipes, knobs and panels to glue onto a flat for a ship interior or a control room.

items.name: A prop from your script, to order
items.blurb: Send the scene and a reference picture. We quote it like any other part: measured, printed, primed, and the hard parts said up front.

items.name: Flintlock pistol, display replica
items.blurb: A solid, one-piece flintlock in the style of the 1700s, our own drawing: no bore, no lock that moves, nothing that opens. Designs from before 1898 are outside the federal marking rule; we still print the muzzle closed.

items.name: Frontier revolver, stage prop
items.blurb: A six-shooter for the stage, drawn new by us, solid through, with a blaze-orange plug fixed in the muzzle.

items.name: Sci-fi blaster, our own design
items.blurb: A blaster from no film but ours, for cosplay and the screen. Printed with an orange band at the muzzle, or whole in a bright colour if you prefer.
specs: orange muzzle band or bright body

items.name: Stage rifle, two-piece, solid
items.blurb: A long gun for theatre and film background, solid, in two halves joined on a steel rod, with an orange band at the muzzle.

items.name: Miniature weapons for figures and dolls
items.blurb: Swords, axes and guns for 1/6-scale figures and smaller, every piece under 38 by 70 mm, the size the marking rule leaves out.

items.name: Unmarked piece for a production, with a waiver
items.blurb: A gun prop with no orange marking ships only to a film, television or theatre production that holds a waiver from the Consumer Product Safety Commission for that piece. We keep a copy of the waiver. Ask first.

items.name: Water bottle top, made to your bottle's thread
items.blurb: Lost or cracked the cap? We measure the neck and print a top that screws on and seals. Hand wash; replace it when it scuffs, because scratches hold bacteria.
specs: stainless nozzle, kept for food work

items.name: Water bottle top with carry loop
items.blurb: The same fitted top with a loop to clip to a bag. Your name on it if you like.
specs: stainless nozzle, kept for food work

items.name: Food-grade printing, made to order
items.blurb: Cookie cutters, stamps, scoops, lids and other short-contact kitchen pieces, printed only in food-contact filament on a nozzle kept for food. A print is not dishwasher-proof and is not certified food-safe: we say so on every order. Quoted per piece.
specs: stainless nozzle, kept for food work
